content:
Post 1
📉 ASX 200 shed 89.60 pts (-0.98%) to 9,038.20 Thursday. Consumer Discretionary cratered 3.18% as earnings reality hit hard. The index is now 2.78% off its 52-week high. Sellers in control. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
Every sector closed red bar two. Consumer Discretionary -3.18%, IT -2.38%, A-REITs -1.45%. Health Care +0.23% and Industrials +0.02% were the only shelter. Nowhere to hide today. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 3
🔺 RHC surged 13.72% to AUD 50.06 — the session's sharpest single-stock move. While the broader market sold off, Ramsay Health Care bucked every trend. One stock, one very different story. #ASX #healthcare

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 6,411.74/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7172. Silver AUD 95.76/oz. Metals firm, but Materials still fell 1.19% — FX and macro drag outweighed the gold floor. #gold #metals #ASX

Post 5
ASX sits 2.78% below its 52-week high. The line in the sand: can 9,000 hold? Watch US data overnight. Are you buying this dip or waiting for the index to prove support first? #ASX #ausbiz
